import json, hashlib
from pathlib import Path
from decimal import Decimal as D, ROUND_HALF_UP
p=Path('products/distribution/sqlite-lemon-squeezy/raw/fees.html')
digest=hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
assert digest=='57b60ad960698fe07b5415f0244d7e52f8e4eebbb9de790a8b98c8143057a5aa'
def money(amount):
    return amount.quantize(D('0.01'),rounding=ROUND_HALF_UP)
price=D('19')
rows=[]
for label,add in [('US card','0'),('international card','0.015'),('US PayPal','0.015'),('international PayPal','0.03')]:
    fee=money(D('0.50')+price*(D('0.05')+D(add)))
    net=price-fee
    rows.append(dict(transaction=label,fee_usd=str(fee),net_before_payout_usd=str(net)))
assert [x['net_before_payout_usd'] for x in rows]==['17.55','17.26','17.26','16.98']
result=dict(source='https://docs.lemonsqueezy.com/help/getting-started/fees',source_sha256=digest,source_extraction_receipt='TASK-179567136110',hypothetical_order_total_usd='19.00',assumptions='One-time order with no tax included in the modeled fee base, no affiliate or recovery charges. Fee rounded half up per order for illustration. USD 19 is a modeling input, not validated pricing.',scenarios=rows,payout_fees='Fee page states 1% per payout to non-US bank accounts via Stripe and 3% capped at $30 per non-US PayPal payout. Payout method, batching, settlement currency, FX, seller activation, timing and distinct paid value remain unverified.',payout_source_gap='Separate payout retrieval returned HTTP 404 in TASK-179567100201. The fee page establishes a fee schedule, not Canadian onboarding or completed settlement.')
dest=Path('products/distribution/sqlite-lemon-squeezy/director-fee-scenarios.json')
dest.parent.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
dest.write_text(json.dumps(result,indent=2)+'\n')
print(dest.read_text())
